tools.name: Toolbay Flow
tools.tagline: Wispr Flow, reverse engineered and free
tools.description:
We reverse engineered Wispr Flow and made it free. Stop paying for dumb shit. Hold a key, speak, let go: clean, punctuated text appears wherever your cursor is. Speech recognition (whisper.cpp) and cleanup (llama.cpp, Qwen3) run on your computer. No account, no word limits, no telemetry.

The Windows version is the most tested. The Mac version is brand new, so tell us in the community if anything is off.

privacy.summary: Not independently reviewed yet. The developer says: runs fully offline after a one-time model download; no account, no servers, no analytics; optional bring-your-own-key cloud cleanup is off by default.
